name: Fairwork Cloudwork Ratings
aliases: Fairwork Cloudwork Ratings 2025: Advancing Standards in Digital Labour and AI Supply Chain Governance

captures.description: THE FAIRWORK CLOUDWORK RATINGS, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'published by the Fairwork Project (spun out of the Oxford Internet Institute and the Berlin Social Science Center WZB). They evaluate online remote digital labor platforms (cloudwork) across five core principles of fairness'. The five principles, the scale out of 10, the general trend ('most remote and freelance cloudwork platforms struggle to meet basic fairness standards', the 2025 assessment of 16 platforms, 'incremental improvements' in recognising the right to organize), the Global South. Eight cards: Oxford's report page and cloudwork page, the WZB, King's College, two Fairwork videos, a trade press piece, Fairwork's certification page.
